description: This file defines the event target implementation for trace2 in a Git-related project. It includes functions for initializing, terminating, and generating various event logs in JSON format, which track different events such as start, exit, signals, errors, commands, timers, counters, and data points. It also sets up configuration options and common behaviors for event logging within the software.

methods.name: int fn_init(void)
methods.description: Initializes event logging settings by checking environment variables for nesting levels and brief mode configurations.

methods.name: void fn_term(void)
methods.description: Terminates event logging.

methods.name: void event_fmt_prepare(const char * event_name,const char * file,int line,const struct repository * repo,struct json_writer * jw)
methods.description: Prepares a JSON object with common event metadata such as event name, session ID, thread, timestamp, file, line, and repository ID.

methods.description: Logs an event indicating too many files are involved.

methods.description: Logs the version information of the JSON data generated.

methods.description: Logs a start event with elapsed time and command arguments.
